_about: jugadadeldia.com English (/en/): for Argentines and people in Argentina. keep = names that stay as written (also allowed by the Spanish-words gate on /en/ pages); terms = Argentine words kept with a short gloss the first time a page needs it, or translated as shown. Used by tools/translate.mjs (docs/I18N.md).
audience: Argentines (and people living in Argentina) who prefer English. Same Argentine substance as the Spanish site: provinces, Argentine pesos, Argentina time, Argentine help lines. Plain, friendly American English, second person (you) for the Spanish vos. Short sentences, no fluff, no new claims.
money: Amounts are Argentine pesos written "$ 1,234" (dollar sign, space, English separators); never convert to US dollars; say "pesos" where the Spanish says pesos.
time: Times stay on the 24-hour clock as written ("21:00"); "hora argentina" = "Argentina time".
